{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "fused_aromatic_surface_partition",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "fused_aromatic_ring_core",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high", "ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "Fused aromatic ring systems bury large rigid nonpolar surface, the dominant positive term in octanol-water partitioning."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_pi_surface",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.4,
          "rationale": "Extended pi surface resists hydration; broad coverage (1982) makes this a well-conditioned surrogate feature."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "nonaromatic_polar_penalty",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_none"},
          "weight": -0.45,
          "rationale": "Fully aliphatic solutes in this pool are typically small and polar, giving low partition coefficients."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "branch_shielding_of_polarity",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high"},
          "weight": 0.3,
          "rationale": "Branch role carried high transfer weight (0.758); alkyl branching adds hydrophobic bulk and shields polar centers."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.4,
      "prior_scale": 0.32,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.5,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.1,
      "gp_beta_end": 0.9,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.62,
      "hypothesis": "High-coverage aromatic and branch descriptors, sharpened by a fused aromatic-ring interaction, drive lipophilicity. Fails if aromatic bulk here co-occurs with ionizable or strongly polar substituents that suppress logD."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "heteroatom_polarity_counter",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "carbon_rich_low_heteroatom",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_low"},
          "weight": 0.55,
          "rationale": "Few heteroatoms means little hydrogen bonding and low desolvation cost, favoring the octanol phase."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_polarity_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Dense heteroatoms give polar contacts and hydration, lowering octanol-water partitioning."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_substituent_partition",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_mid"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Halogen substituents add polarizable, weakly hydrated surface; halogen_mid (743) has usable coverage unlike halogen_high."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "length_transfer_downweight",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": -0.15,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: reverses the low-confidence (0.22) inverted length transfer; long scaffolds often carry many polar groups."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.8,
      "prior_scale": 0.28,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.06,
      "ucb_weight": 0.45,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 0.9,
      "gp_xi": 0.025,
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "hypothesis": "Polarity content, not molecular size, sets lipophilicity; the inverted ESOL length relation is explicitly reversed. Fails if hetero_low (194) is too sparse to anchor the surrogate early."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "fused_aromatic_surface_partition",
  "lesson": "Across two development generations the aromatic/branch skill matched or beat the ESOL length-inversion skill on both mean AUC and mean final best, so broad-coverage surface descriptors are the safer deployment; sparse bins remain weak surrogate features.",
  "revision_summary": "Promoted the aromatic/branch family to deployment and sharpened it with a fused aromatic-ring interaction while dropping the redundant very-long-length rule. Built the counter-hypothesis around heteroatom polarity and moderate halogenation, explicitly reversing the low-confidence inverted length transfer rather than repeating it. Semantic mass still decays toward the target-only anchor; all conditions map exact catalog fields to exact catalog values, and no target outcomes were used."
}
